faq.question: What can I use ICSDC Cloud Storage for?
faq.answer: You can use it to store business documents, backups, application data, media files, and personal files in a secure cloud environment.

faq.question: Is my data secure in ICSDC Cloud Storage?
faq.answer: Yes. Data is stored using secure infrastructure with access controls and standard security practices to protect files from unauthorised access.

faq.question: Can I access my files from different locations?
faq.answer: Yes. You can securely access your stored data from anywhere with an internet connection, making it useful for remote teams and distributed work.

faq.question: Can I share files with other people?
faq.answer: Yes. Files can be shared using access-controlled links, allowing you to decide who can view or download your data.

faq.question: Can I increase storage capacity later?
faq.answer: Absolutely. Storage can be increased anytime as your data grows, without moving files or changing your setup.

faq.question: Is cloud storage suitable for backups?
faq.answer: Yes. Many users rely on ICSDC Cloud Storage for backups to protect important data from accidental deletion or system failures.

faq.question: Do I need technical skills to use cloud storage?
faq.answer: No. The storage interface is designed to be simple and easy to use, while ICSDC manages the underlying infrastructure.

faq.question: What happens if I need help or support?
faq.answer: ICSDC provides support to assist with access issues, usage questions, and general guidance whenever needed.
